scenes.description: BLANK STOCK — Bone stock. Crop marks snap to four corners in sequence. Colour-calibration bar draws L→R along the top edge. Margin micro-type sets.
scenes.framing: full-bleed bone field, all four margins visible
scenes.movement: crop marks snap in sequence; colour bar draws L→R
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'SHEET 01 · 175 LPI · C-41'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: empty press sheet + registration furniture. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: KEY PLATE — Black key plate slams down: type only, huge, bleeding both edges. Registration crosshairs flash once.
scenes.framing: type bleeding off both edges, baseline low
scenes.movement: plate slams down from +40px with a hard stop
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'SHINJUKU'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: the word SHINJUKU as a black ink plate. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: MISREGISTER — Crimson plate drops 14px off-register. Ghosted double-edge under the black. Jitters twice.
scenes.framing: same lockup as s02, crimson offset 14px up-left
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'PLATE 2/4 · CRIMSON'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: the crimson plate, out of register. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: SNAP — Plate registers with a hard click. A crimson bar rockets across the frame and stops dead. PROTOCOL lands beneath SHINJUKU.
scenes.framing: horizontal band at the type's optical centre
scenes.movement: bar rockets L→R and stops dead; PROTOCOL drops in
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'PROTOCOL'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: a crimson bar crossing the frame. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: WINDOW OPENS — Roller wipe cuts an image-window into the sheet. A band only — the hand, the glass. Halftone dots at the window edge.
scenes.framing: letterbox slot, lower third, poster band inside
scenes.movement: hard-edged roller wipe L→R reveals the window
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'IMAGE PLATE 3/4'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: the image window opening in the sheet. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: DUOTONE FLIP — The window flips full-colour → crimson/ink duotone → back, on the beat. Plate label ticks over.
scenes.movement: duotone flip full-colour → crimson/ink → back, on beat
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'SEPARATION'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: the separated colour plates themselves. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: TYPE THROUGH ARTWORK — SIGNATURE SHOT. Full-bleed SHINJUKU, letterforms filled with the poster artwork, everything else bone. Letters track out slowly.
scenes.framing: full-bleed type, artwork visible only inside the glyphs
scenes.movement: letters track out 0.06em; artwork drifts 30px behind
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'SHINJUKU'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: the poster artwork seen through the letterforms. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: COLD INVERSION — Ink field. Cold cyan reticle, grid and coordinates draw on. Small image window centred.
scenes.framing: small centred window in a large ink field
scenes.movement: reticle rings draw; coordinates type on character by character
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: "35°41'N 139°46'E". Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: a cold technical overlay — reticle, grid, coordinates. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: TRIPTYCH — Three vertical panels slide in at different speeds — the three poster treatments. Rotated side-bar type on each.
scenes.movement: panels slide in at 3 different speeds and stagger to rest
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'FILM C-41 / SHEET 02 / NO WITNESS'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: three panels of the same film, side by side. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: ROLLER WIPE — A hard-edged crimson roller sweeps across, leaving PROTOCOL knocked out in white. Halftone density ramps under it.
scenes.framing: full-frame sweep, PROTOCOL knocked out white
scenes.movement: roller sweeps L→R; halftone density ramps beneath it
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'PROTOCOL'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: the crimson roller. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: ASSEMBLY — All four plates converge on four beats — stock, key, crimson, image. Barcode draws in.
scenes.movement: four beats — stock, key, crimson, image — each landing hard; barcode draws
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: '2023.04.29'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: the four plates converging into one sheet. Distinct from the beat before and after.

scenes.description: LOCKUP — Dead still. Full poster lockup: crop marks, colour bar, barcode, date, coordinates, ►►►. One halftone shimmer settles over 0.4s, then nothing moves.
scenes.movement: nothing. one halftone shimmer settles over 0.4s, then absolute stillness
scenes.overlay_notes: On-screen copy: 'SHINJUKU PROTOCOL'. Persistent furniture layer (crop marks, colour bar, micro-type) stays on throughout.
scenes.shot_intent: Primary visual subject: the finished poster. Distinct from the beat before and after.

metadata.transition_note: One family only — hard cut. All motion happens INSIDE shots as press mechanics (plate drop, misregister jitter, roller wipe, panel slide, shimmer). No dissolves, no glitch, no shatter.

metadata.scene_distinctness_check: No two scenes share a primary visual subject. Nearest pair is s02/s03 (both the SHINJUKU lockup) — s02's subject is the black plate arriving, s03's is the crimson plate failing to register; different plate, different colour, different motion register. Accepted.
metadata.signature_device: Type-as-window: poster artwork visible only inside the letterforms. Used in exactly one beat (s07) so it stays scarce.
metadata.subject_motion_law: The man never moves. Every frame he appears in is a still plate. All motion belongs to the layout.
